scripts.build:chrome: npm run build:packages && webpack --config scripts/webpack.webext.config.js --env target=chrome --mode production
scripts.build:chrome:dev: npm run build:packages && webpack --config scripts/webpack.webext.config.js --env target=chrome --mode development
scripts.build:electron: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspace @once/electron
scripts.build:extensions: npm run build:packages && webpack --config scripts/webpack.webext.config.js --env target=firefox --mode production && webpack --config scripts/webpack.webext.config.js --env target=chrome --mode production
scripts.build:extensions:dev: npm run build:packages && webpack --config scripts/webpack.webext.config.js --env target=firefox --mode development && webpack --config scripts/webpack.webext.config.js --env target=chrome --mode development
scripts.build:firefox: npm run build:packages && webpack --config scripts/webpack.webext.config.js --env target=firefox --mode production
scripts.build:firefox:dev: npm run build:packages && webpack --config scripts/webpack.webext.config.js --env target=firefox --mode development
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run check:types && npm run check:boundaries && npm run build:extensions:dev && npm run build:electron && npm run build:mobile:dev
scripts.deploy:mobile:android: npm run mobile -- deploy android --channel release
scripts.make:electron: npm run build:packages && node apps/electron/scripts/run-forge.js make
scripts.make:electron:dev: npm run build:packages && node apps/electron/scripts/run-forge.js make --dev
scripts.package:electron: npm run build:packages && node apps/electron/scripts/run-forge.js package
scripts.package:electron:dev: npm run build:packages && node apps/electron/scripts/run-forge.js package --dev
scripts.package:mobile:android: npm run mobile -- package android --channel release
scripts.package:mobile:ios: npm run mobile -- package ios --channel release
scripts.run:mobile:android: npm run mobile -- run android --channel dev
scripts.run:mobile:android:emulator: npm run mobile -- run android --channel dev --target Pixel_7_API_36_AOSP
scripts.run:mobile:ios: npm run mobile -- run ios --channel dev
scripts.start:electron: npm run build:packages && npm run start --workspace @once/electron
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:electron && npm run test:extensions && npm run test:electron:e2e
scripts.test:collectors: npm run build:packages && node --test tests/unit/parser/*.test.js tests/unit/collectors/*.test.js
scripts.test:electron: npm run build:electron && node --test tests/integration/electron/*.test.js tests/integration/app/*.test.js
scripts.test:electron:e2e: npm run package:electron && playwright test --config tests/e2e/electron/playwright.config.js
scripts.test:electron:e2e:story-debug: npm run package:electron && npm run test:electron:e2e:story-debug:run
scripts.test:extensions: npm run build:extensions && node --test tests/e2e/extensions/artifacts.test.js && web-ext lint --source-dir apps/firefox-extension/dist/release && playwright test --config tests/e2e/extensions/playwright.config.js && node --test tests/e2e/extensions/firefox.test.js tests/e2e/extensions/firefox-stories.test.js tests/e2e/extensions/geny-firefox.test.js
scripts.test:mobile: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspace @once/mobile && node --test tests/unit/mobile/*.test.js
scripts.test:mobile:web: npm run mobile -- web --channel dev --e2e && playwright test --config tests/e2e/mobile/playwright.config.js
